method: FAO-56 daily PM; daily mean RH vapor pressure approximation; G=0; observed horizontal solar kWh/m2/day converted to MJ/m2/day
data_source: User-provided 2024 date-aligned paired AgriMet and NASA POWER daily CSVs
station_wind_assumption: 3 m sensitivity assumption based on USBR 2012 network change; not verified station-specific for 2024
notes: Preliminary sensitivity results, not calibrated or independently benchmark-verified
No imputation; 366 daily ET0 values per source and region passed basic range screening
Annual totals computed from unrounded daily ET0; monthly figures are rounded
Station wind height is unverified; station ET0 requires release gate
Gridded input comparison is not field validation
